risks.title: Intense competition and pricing pressure
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned first in operational risks, the language is strong ('unable to compete successfully', 'loss of market share'). Competition is described as intense and diversified, with more established players. Weighting is high as this is a fundamental risk to growth and profitability.

risks.title: International operations and trade risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed with numerous sub-points (political, economic, currencies, regulations, sanctions, etc.). The language is strong ('substantial international operations subject us to risks', 'material adverse impact'). High severity is justified by the strong reliance on international sales (79%).

risks.title: Dependence on and retention of key personnel
risks.score_rationale: This risk is highlighted by dependence on specific executives and the need to attract and retain technical talent. The language is strong ('adverse impact', 'material adverse effect'). The technical nature of the business and reliance on specific individuals justify high severity.

risks.title: Volatility in raw material prices and availability
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly identified with multiple causes (suppliers, regulations, exchange rates, global events). The language is strong ('material adverse impact', 'adversely affected'). The impact on margins and the ability to pass through costs is significant.

risks.title: Failure to execute business strategy
risks.score_rationale: This risk relates to the ability to innovate and adapt to technological trends and customer needs. The language is precise ('inability to anticipate', 'adapt to emerging trends', 'could adversely affect'). The strategy is focused on technological innovation.

risks.title: Risks related to acquisitions and divestitures
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed with operational, financial, and management challenges. The language is cautious ('may not realize anticipated benefits', 'potential disputes'). Acquisitions and divestitures are an active strategy of the company (sale of MacDermid Graphics Solutions, acquisitions of EFC and Micromax).

risks.title: Dependence on key customers, suppliers, and distributors
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned regarding the loss of major customers and reliance on suppliers and distributors. The language is moderate ('may impair', 'no assurance'). While not dependent on a single customer, concentration could still pose a risk.

ai_positioning.summary: The company ESI does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
